newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait premier leaves for Britain after surgery.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait premier leaves for Britain after surgery.

text.p: Kuwait's Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah left for Britain on Monday to complete medical treatment after "successful" colon surgery in Kuwait last week, an official statement said.
The statement by the emiri court, read on state television, said Sheikh Saad, born 1930, left for Britain to "continue medical treatement and for recuperation".

Sheikh Saad, who has been prime minister and heir apparent since 1978, was rushed to a Kuwait City hospital on Tuesday after fainting due to internal bleeding. He was released on Thursday, but returned to hospital a day later.
On Saturday Sheikh Saad underwent colon surgery.
Earlier on Monday aviation sources told Reuters Sheikh Saad was due to leave the country aboard a medical aircraft sent to Kuwait last week by Saudi Arabia's King Fahd.
The head of Sheikh Saad's medical team Hilal Mesaed al-Sayer said on Sunday the premier's condition was "stable and excellent".
